preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access privileged functions
Contract must have accumulated tokens in its balance (>= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity = 250000 * 10^15 tokens)
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true (default is true)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner: 1) Ensure swapAndLiquifyEnabled is true using setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(true). 2) Set high liquidity and tax fees using setLiquidityFeePercent() and setTaxFeePercent() to maximize token accumulation. 3) Exclude the marketing address (0x1E0A894269812ae0CeAb7f10e25b885d3beBA110) from fees using excludeFromFee(). 4) Trigger multiple large transfers to/from the Uniswap pair to accumulate tokens in the contract balance. 5) Once contract balance exceeds numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity, the swapAndLiquify function will automatically execute, swapping tokens for BNB and transferring 2/3 of the swapped BNB to the marketing wallet. 6) Repeat transfers to drain liquidity pool funds to the team/marketing wallet controlled by the owner.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: This is an owner privilege abuse vulnerability in a reflection token with swapAndLiquify mechanism. The contract owner can: 1) Change the marketing address via storage manipulation, 2) Set high liquidity fees to accumulate tokens, 3) Trigger swapAndLiquify which swaps tokens for BNB and sends 2/3 to the marketing wallet. The attacker can impersonate the owner, redirect the marketing address to themselves, accumulate tokens in the contract, and drain BNB from the liquidity mechanism.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1) Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank(), 2) Use vm.store() to change _marketingAddress storage slot to attacker's address, 3) Set high liquidity fee percent to maximize token accumulation, 4) Exclude attacker from fees to preserve tokens, 5) Deal tokens to attacker and transfer to contract to exceed numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity threshold, 6) The transfer triggers swapAndLiquify which swaps tokens for BNB and sends 2/3 to attacker (now marketing address)
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Load owner address from storage slot 0 (Ownable._owner), 2. Start prank as owner, 3. Overwrite _marketingAddress at storage slot 9 to attacker address, 4. Call setLiquidityFeePercent(50) to maximize fees, 5. Call excludeFromFee(attacker) to avoid fee loss, 6. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(true), 7. Stop prank, 8. Deal 300000*1e15 tokens to attacker (above 250000*1e15 threshold), 9. Transfer tokens to contract triggering swapAndLiquify, 10. Assert attacker received BNB
